sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·朗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店里用黑胶唱片当DJ的那个年代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带着你最珍视的300件宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼带来的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, President Trump has called Nancy Pelosi incompetent and called Chuck Schumer a loser.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统称南希·佩洛西无能，并称查克·舒默是个失败者。

sentences.en: Now, he's striking deals with the two most powerful Democrats in Washington and sending out tweets at their requeSt.
sentences.zh: 现在，他却在与华盛顿这两位最有权势的民主党人达成协议，并应他们的要求发布推文。

sentences.en: And after meeting with the president, Senator Schumer gives his version of the story.
sentences.zh: 在与总统会面后，舒默参议员讲述了他版本的故事。

sentences.en: It's Friday, September 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月8日，星期五。

sentences.en: Glenn, what was this phone call on Thursday morning?
sentences.zh: 格伦，周四早上那通电话是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Well, the president called his newfound friend, Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 嗯，总统给他新结识的朋友南希·佩洛西打了电话。

sentences.en: When he called this morning, I said, thanks for calling.
sentences.zh: 当他今天早上打来电话时，我说，谢谢你的来电。

sentences.en: And she said, look.
sentences.zh: 她说，听着。

sentences.en: People really need a reassurance from you, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，人们真的需要你的安抚。

sentences.en: This policy that you've announced of a six-month review of DACA, the Dreamers program, is scaring the hell out of 800,000 of these young immigrants.
sentences.zh: 你宣布的对“追梦人”计划（DACA）进行六个月审查的政策，让这80万年轻移民感到恐惧万分。

sentences.en: These people will not be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 这些人不应该处于这种脆弱的境地。

sentences.en: Could you do something to reassure them more forcefully that they are not going to get deported?
sentences.zh: 你能不能采取一些更有力的措施来让他们放心，保证他们不会被驱逐出境？

sentences.en: Boom, boom, boom.
sentences.zh: 砰，砰，砰。

sentences.en: The tweet appeared.
sentences.zh: 推文出现了。

sentences.en: Quote, for all of those DACA that are concerned about your status during the six-month period, you have nothing to worry about.
sentences.zh: 引用如下：对于所有担心六个月期间身份问题的DACA受益人，你们无需担心。

sentences.en: No action.
sentences.zh: 不会有任何行动。

sentences.en: Pretty stunning that a simple Nancy Pelosi interaction could get him to do what he'd refuse to do for 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，与南希·佩洛西的一次简单互动，就能让他去做他此前拒绝了48小时的事情。

sentences.en: So, this phone call with Nancy Pelosi was kind of just the cap to an unexpected week with President Trump and Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以，这通与南希·佩洛西的电话，算是特朗普总统与民主党人这意想不到的一周的压轴戏。

sentences.en: It seemed to start really badly for the Democrats because the president rescinds DACA.
sentences.zh: 这对民主党人来说似乎开局非常糟糕，因为总统废除了DACA。

sentences.en: But then there's this meeting at the White House on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 但随后周三在白宫举行了那次会议。

sentences.en: What was that meeting supposed to be and who was there?
sentences.zh: 那次会议原本是为了什么？都有谁参加了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, let me set the scene for you.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我为你还原一下当时的场景。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 那是周三。

sentences.en: The president has called a bipartisan meeting in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 总统在椭圆形办公室召集了一次两党会议。

sentences.en: They start trickling in.
sentences.zh: 他们开始陆续进场。

sentences.en: Paul Ryan and Mitch McConnell on the Republican side.
sentences.zh: 共和党方面的保罗·瑞安和米奇·麦康奈尔。

sentences.en: The vice president comes over from the executive office into the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 副总统从行政大楼走到了椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer is driven over from the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默从国会大厦开车过来。

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi enters the room.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西走进房间。

sentences.en: And they are there essentially to start, not conclude, negotiations on what looks like a hellish September.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里的本质目的是为了开启，而不是结束，关于九月这个地狱般月份的谈判。

sentences.en: And the two big things that they're looking at, raising the debt ceiling, the chronic headache that often leads to government shutdowns if deals can't be made.
sentences.zh: 他们关注的两件大事是：提高债务上限——这通常是导致政府停摆的慢性头痛问题，如果无法达成协议的话；

sentences.en: And creating a short-term spending bill.
sentences.zh: 以及制定一项短期支出法案。

sentences.en: And on top of that, the catalyst for making something happen was this massive Harvey, Hurricane Harvey relief bill.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，促成这一切的催化剂是那项大规模的哈维飓风救灾法案。

sentences.en: They're there sitting on these couches.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在沙发上。

sentences.en: They do the photo op.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了拍照环节。

sentences.en: And they think they think they're just going to have a preliminary kind of a photo op of a conversation to just start things.
sentences.zh: 他们以为这只是一个初步的、象征性的谈话，仅仅是为了开个头。

sentences.en: But that's not what happens.
sentences.zh: 但事情并没有按预想发展。

sentences.en: The president, Michael, had other plans.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，总统另有打算。

sentences.en: The president met with congressional leaders this morning.
sentences.zh: 总统今天早上会见了国会领导人。

sentences.en: So the main thing that had to be dealt with was the debt ceiling, because without that, you can't do any of the other spending bills.
sentences.zh: 所以最需要处理的主要问题是债务上限，因为没有它，你就无法进行任何其他支出法案的谈判。

sentences.en: So here's how it lined up.
sentences.zh: 事情的进展是这样的。

sentences.en: Republicans wanted a longer deal on the debt limit.
sentences.zh: 共和党人希望就债务上限达成一项长期协议。

sentences.en: Senator McConnell and the president's own Treasury secretary, Stephen Mnuchin, advocated for an 18-month extension of the debt ceiling.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔参议员和总统自己的财政部长史蒂芬·姆努钦主张将债务上限延长18个月。

sentences.en: 18 months through the midterm elections, but Democrats refused.
sentences.zh: 18个月，直到中期选举之后，但民主党人拒绝了。

sentences.en: And Mnuchin really, and this is a remarkable scene, just picture this in your mind's eye, Mnuchin is kind of leaning forward in his chair.
sentences.zh: 姆努钦真的很卖力，这是一个引人注目的场景，你可以在脑海中想象一下，姆努钦身体前倾坐在椅子上。

sentences.en: You've got the Democratic leadership and the Republican leadership on couches, the president in a wingback chair, the vice president sitting next to him.
sentences.zh: 民主党领导层和共和党领导层坐在沙发上，总统坐在翼背椅上，副总统坐在他旁边。

sentences.en: Mnuchin is passionately making a case for an 18-month extension, saying the markets needed it for stability.
sentences.zh: 姆努钦充满激情地为18个月的延期辩护，称市场需要它来保持稳定。

sentences.en: And boom.
sentences.zh: 然后，砰。

sentences.en: In a stunning move, President Trump bucking his own party.
sentences.zh: 在一个惊人的举动中，特朗普总统违背了他自己的党派。

sentences.en: President Trump interrupts him, points to Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer, who have been pushing this three-month deal, points to them and says, I'm going with them.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统打断了他，指向一直推动三个月协议的南希·佩洛西和查克·舒默，指着他们说，我支持他们。

sentences.en: He broke with the GOP and sided with Democrats on a bill that provides hurricane relief, raises the debt limit, and funds the government for three months.
sentences.zh: 他与共和党决裂，站在民主党一边，支持了一项提供飓风救灾、提高债务上限并为政府提供三个月资金的法案。

sentences.en: It was a remarkable moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非凡的时刻。

sentences.en: From everything that I've done in terms of reporting in the room, the Republicans responded essentially by gasping.
sentences.zh: 根据我在现场了解到的情况，共和党人的反应基本上是倒吸一口凉气。

sentences.en: Republican leaders left to answer questions on the president's unexpected deal-making.
sentences.zh: 共和党领导人离开现场，去回答关于总统出人意料的交易行为的问题。

sentences.en: So let me get this straight, Glenn.
sentences.zh: 格伦，让我理清一下。

sentences.en: We are in the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们在白宫。

sentences.en: You have leaders from both chambers and both parties negotiating this debt ceiling.
sentences.zh: 你有来自两院和两党的领导人正在就债务上限进行谈判。

sentences.en: And Trump just takes the side of the Democrats.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普直接站在了民主党这一边。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like if you walked into the prom with your date and you get over to the punch bowl and then you walk over and ask somebody else to the prom.
sentences.zh: 这就像你带着舞伴去参加舞会，走到潘趣酒台旁，然后你走过去邀请了别人跳舞。

sentences.en: So, Glenn, what's the significance of choosing the Democratic plan?
sentences.zh: 那么，格伦，选择民主党方案的意义何在？

sentences.en: Do we know why he went with the Democratic plan?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他为什么选择民主党方案吗？

sentences.en: It actually makes an awful lot of sense politically and it's something we've expected him to do since he was elected.
sentences.zh: 从政治上讲，这其实非常有道理，而且这是我们自他当选以来就一直期待他做的事情。

sentences.en: Remember, Donald Trump did not run as a conventional Republican.
sentences.zh: 记住，唐纳德·特朗普竞选时并不是一个传统的共和党人。

sentences.en: He initially didn't want to take a loyalty pledge.
sentences.zh: 他起初并不想签署忠诚誓言。

sentences.en: So we'd expected him to cut all kinds of deals with Democrats, particularly on infrastructure, but he hasn't.
sentences.zh: 所以我们曾期待他与民主党人达成各种交易，特别是在基础设施方面，但他并没有这样做。

sentences.en: And it seems to me now that he realizes in order to sort of save his presidency and get any real accomplishment, he's going to need to start working with Democrats.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他现在意识到，为了挽救他的总统任期并取得任何真正的成就，他需要开始与民主党人合作。

sentences.en: And, Michael, the other element is it's shocking.
sentences.zh: 而且，迈克尔，另一个因素是这很令人震惊。

sentences.en: This is a guy who likes drama and this made a big splash.
sentences.zh: 他是一个喜欢戏剧性的人，这引起了巨大的轰动。

sentences.en: So what's going on with the actual personalities involved that we should understand?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们应该如何理解这些当事人之间的个性？

sentences.en: It's really clear that Donald Trump does not like Mitch McConnell.
sentences.zh: 很明显，唐纳德·特朗普不喜欢米奇·麦康奈尔。

sentences.en: Same holds true for Paul Ryan.
sentences.zh: 保罗·瑞安也是如此。

sentences.en: The president will never forgive Paul Ryan for basically abandoning him after the Access Hollywood tape.
sentences.zh: 总统永远不会原谅保罗·瑞安在《走进好莱坞》录音带事件后基本上抛弃了他。

sentences.en: Chuck Schumer is an Outerboro guy, a scrambler, somebody the president dealt with on real estate stuff.
sentences.zh: 查克·舒默是一个纽约外区人，一个精明能干的人，一个总统在房地产领域打过交道的人。

sentences.en: His father and my grandfather were builders together in Brooklyn.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲和我祖父曾经在布鲁克林一起做建筑生意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In an odd way, he's got a lot more in common with these two coastal, quote unquote, elite liberals than he does with the people in his own party.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，他与这两个所谓的沿海精英自由派的共同点，比他与自己党内人士的共同点要多得多。

sentences.en: I was very proud of Chuck Schumer.
sentences.zh: 我为查克·舒默感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: He could speak New York to the president.
sentences.zh: 他能用总统听得懂的“纽约话”与他交流。

sentences.en: And I think what Mitch McConnell and Mark Short, the president's legislative director, fully realized,
sentences.zh: 我认为米奇·麦康奈尔和总统的立法主任马克·肖特完全意识到了这一点，

sentences.en: or you just read it on their faces in the photographs, was that the president had let Chuck Schumer into the room.
sentences.zh: 或者你从照片中他们的表情就能看出来，总统让查克·舒默进入了核心圈子。

sentences.en: And that in and of itself changes the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 这本身就改变了动态。

sentences.en: Tell me what you mean.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的意思。

sentences.en: And I want to talk about that photo.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈那张照片。

sentences.en: When a photographer captured Chuck Schumer through the White House window during this meeting that we're talking about, Schumer looks thrilled.
sentences.zh: 当摄影师在这次会议期间透过白宫窗户拍到查克·舒默时，舒默看起来非常兴奋。

sentences.en: It's Chuck being Chuck.
sentences.zh: 这就是查克的本色。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the way the guy, you know, back slapping, making jokes, you know, reminding them of stuff that they've done together in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是他的风格，你知道，拍拍肩膀，开开玩笑，提醒他们过去一起做过的事情。

sentences.en: I don't know what he said to them, but anyone who's ever dealt with Chuck Schumer knows how he operates.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他对他们说了什么，但任何与查克·舒默打过交道的人都知道他的行事风格。

sentences.en: And it's really a very tactile.
sentences.zh: 这真的很讲究触感。

sentences.en: You can see them physically engaging with one another.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到他们之间有身体上的互动。

sentences.en: It's like two guys at a diner.
sentences.zh: 就像餐馆里的两个老伙计。

sentences.en: And that cultural dynamic for a guy like Trump, by the way, Michael, who misses New York every minute of every day, there's a certain home cooking aspect to being around Chuck.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，迈克尔，对于像特朗普这样每天每分钟都想念纽约的人来说，这种文化动态，和查克在一起有一种宾至如归的感觉。

sentences.en: And I think, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，你知道，

sentences.en: that's something that all these Midwesterners and Southerners who he who he by political necessity has to ally himself to will never be able to deliver to the president.
sentences.zh: 这是所有那些他出于政治需要而必须结盟的中西部人和南方人永远无法带给总统的东西。

sentences.en: I'm struck that both Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer were so eager to talk about their interactions with Trump in such a public way to basically to boast about asking for something and getting it from this president.
sentences.zh: 我感到惊讶的是，南希·佩洛西和查克·舒默都如此渴望以如此公开的方式谈论他们与特朗普的互动，基本上是在吹嘘他们向总统提出了要求并得到了满足。

sentences.en: Isn't that potentially dangerous and counterproductive for Democrats?
sentences.zh: 这对民主党人来说难道不是潜在的危险和适得其反吗？

sentences.en: This is a president, as you know, who likes to seem in control and totally independent.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，这位总统喜欢表现得掌控一切且完全独立。

sentences.en: So the suggestion that he is obeying Democrats seems like it could very easily backfire, right?
sentences.zh: 所以暗示他听命于民主党人似乎很容易适得其反，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, but they're playing with House money.
sentences.zh: 是的，但他们是在用赢来的钱玩游戏。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: I mean, they weren't in the conversation before this that, you know, they all they were just outside screaming, raising money, writing press releases.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在此之前他们根本不在对话圈内，你知道，他们只是在外面大喊大叫、筹集资金、写新闻稿。

sentences.en: Nobody was reading.
sentences.zh: 没人看那些东西。

sentences.en: And now Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer at the center of the conversation.
sentences.zh: 而现在南希·佩洛西和查克·舒默处于对话的中心。

sentences.en: If he turns on them in two days and says to hell with you, I don't want to do business with you anymore because you've been boasting.
sentences.zh: 如果他在两天后反过来对他们说，去你的，我不想再和你们做生意了，因为你们一直在吹嘘。

sentences.en: They'll be like, great.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，太好了。

sentences.en: We had a great two days and now we can slam him for not doing deals to make in the benefit of the American people.
sentences.zh: 我们度过了很棒的两天，现在我们可以抨击他不为美国人民的利益达成交易。

sentences.en: This is literally a win-win situation as much as you'll ever see it in politics for these guys.
sentences.zh: 对于这些人来说，这在政治上绝对是一个双赢的局面。

sentences.en: Is it possible that President Trump, despite the way he campaigned and has governed for the first six months, actually could be this kind of breakthrough figure for bipartisanship?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统尽管有他竞选和执政前六个月的方式，是否真的可能成为这种两党合作的突破性人物？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对可能。

sentences.en: I mean, look, you have to run the government.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，你必须管理政府。

sentences.en: And the basic mechanism of putting your hands on and running the government changes the dynamic.
sentences.zh: 而亲手管理政府的基本机制改变了动态。

sentences.en: The thing that was also really different, Michael, about what he did in this meeting is he took charge.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他在这次会议中所做的另一件真正不同的事情是，他接管了指挥权。

sentences.en: Mike Pence sat there and didn't say a word.
sentences.zh: 迈克·彭斯坐在那里一言不发。

sentences.en: During the health care negotiations, Mike Pence was his lead negotiator.
sentences.zh: 在医疗保健谈判期间，迈克·彭斯是他的首席谈判代表。

sentences.en: It helps that the issues are sufficiently broad and political in this that the president is conversant enough to know about them.
sentences.zh: 这些问题在政治上足够广泛，总统对此足够熟悉，这很有帮助。

sentences.en: But, you know, we've been talking about this question of him outsourcing leadership to the Hill.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我们一直在讨论他将领导权外包给国会的问题。

sentences.en: This kind of move, if it's sustained, represents actual leadership.
sentences.zh: 这种举动，如果能持续下去，就代表了真正的领导力。

sentences.en: And you can tell because the Republicans were seizing in private and giving us all kinds of colorful background and off the record remarks.
sentences.zh: 你可以看出来，因为共和党人在私下里感到恐慌，并向我们提供了各种各样的背景信息和非正式评论。

sentences.en: But when it came to being on the record and voting, Republican leadership quickly fell into line.
sentences.zh: 但当涉及到正式记录和投票时，共和党领导层很快就归队了。

sentences.en: So let's come back to Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们回到周四早上。

sentences.en: These are the five things to know for your new day on Thursday, September 7th.
sentences.zh: 这是9月7日星期四你需要知道的五件事。

sentences.en: The news coverage is all about the president striking this deal with congressional Democrats on the budget and getting something done.
sentences.zh: 新闻报道的焦点全是总统与国会民主党人就预算达成协议并取得成果。

sentences.en: Strange bedfellows.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的盟友。

sentences.en: President Trump strikes a surprise budget deal with Democrats.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统与民主党人达成了一项令人惊讶的预算协议。

sentences.en: He was able to do something he hasn't been able to do for the first seven and a half months of his presence.
sentences.zh: 他做到了他在总统任期的前七个半月里一直没能做到的事情。

sentences.en: President Trump campaigned on a vow to make great deals.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统竞选时承诺要达成伟大的交易。

sentences.en: And this morning, the White House says that agreement he struck with Democrats shows he's fulfilling that promise.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，白宫表示，他与民主党人达成的协议表明他正在履行这一承诺。

sentences.en: So do you think that feedback he's getting is what explains this call and conversation to Pelosi,
sentences.zh: 所以你认为他得到的反馈是否解释了这次给佩洛西的通话和谈话，

sentences.en: that he's excited about getting work done with Congress, rings her up, strikes another smaller deal to send that reassuring tweet about DACA?
sentences.zh: 他因为能与国会完成工作而感到兴奋，于是打电话给她，达成了另一项较小的协议，发出了那条关于DACA的安抚推文？

sentences.en: Is that kind of how we explain it?
sentences.zh: 我们是这样解释的吗？

sentences.en: Look, there's this great scene in the second Lord of the Rings where there's this king who is trapped really under the thrall of this advisor for a long time.
sentences.zh: 听着，在《指环王》第二部里有一个很棒的场景，有一位国王长期被他的顾问所控制。

sentences.en: And then someone comes along and kind of throws the advisor out of the castle and the king changes his entire perspective.
sentences.zh: 然后有人出现，把顾问赶出了城堡，国王的整个视角就改变了。

sentences.en: I think you're seeing a little of that right now with Bannon.
sentences.zh: 我认为你现在在班农身上也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: Bannon being out of the White House, even though Bannon lost a lot of influence internally and Steve Miller, his protege, is still there.
sentences.zh: 班农离开了白宫，尽管班农在内部失去了很多影响力，而他的门徒斯蒂芬·米勒仍然在那里。

sentences.en: I think there is a sense that Bannon's political theory of the case, sir, stick with the right wing.
sentences.zh: 我认为有一种感觉，班农的政治理论是：先生，坚持右翼立场。

sentences.en: If you diverge from the core of your party, you are going to get killed.
sentences.zh: 如果你偏离了你党派的核心，你就会被干掉。

sentences.en: I think the fact that Bannon is not physically in the building advocating that position means that Trump is now open to explore new alternatives.
sentences.zh: 我认为班农不在大楼里倡导这一立场的事实，意味着特朗普现在愿意探索新的选择。

sentences.en: So it sounds like what you're saying is that we're seeing the real Trump, the Bannon-less Trump, which is far more open to drifting across the aisle and working with Democrats.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来你的意思是，我们正在看到真正的特朗普，那个没有班农的特朗普，他更愿意跨越党派界限与民主党人合作。

sentences.en: I think he's far more open to drifting.
sentences.zh: 我认为他更愿意跨越界限。

sentences.en: He's not tethered to any of the conventional motives of normal politicians, ideology, even sort of the exercise of raw power.
sentences.zh: 他不受正常政客的任何传统动机束缚，无论是意识形态，甚至是某种原始权力的行使。

sentences.en: What he is is he wants to prove to people that he can do this and he wants to stay alive.
sentences.zh: 他想要的是向人们证明他能做到这一点，并且他想生存下去。

sentences.en: So he's going to ultimately move around the political map to wherever he needs to be that keeps him going.
sentences.zh: 所以他最终会根据需要移动到政治版图上的任何位置，以保持他的前进。

sentences.en: This is a real moment in the presidency.
sentences.zh: 这是总统任期内的一个真正时刻。

sentences.en: If he decides to cling back to the base, we know he's stuck in this rut.
sentences.zh: 如果他决定退回基本盘，那我们就知道他陷入了这种陈规陋习。

sentences.en: But if he's able to sort of expand outward and bring some of the base with him while bringing new people, well, that's real politics, not this other stuff that we've seen.
sentences.zh: 但如果他能向外拓展，在引入新人的同时带上部分基本盘，那才是真正的政治，而不是我们之前见到的那些把戏。

sentences.en: So this is the moment, the real test of Donald Trump as a politician.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个关键时刻，是对唐纳德·特朗普作为政治家的一次真正考验。

sentences.en: Glenn Trush, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 格伦·特鲁什，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I think we will have a different relationship than you've been watching over the last number of years.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们将拥有与过去几年你所看到的不同关系。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: I think that's a great thing for our country.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对我们的国家来说是一件好事。

sentences.en: And I think that's what the people of the United States want to see.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这正是美国人民想要看到的。

sentences.en: They want to see some dialogue.
sentences.zh: 他们想要看到一些对话。

sentences.en: They want to see coming together to an extent, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们想要看到至少在某种程度上达成共识。

sentences.en: And I think you see that with DACA.
sentences.zh: 我想你在“童年抵美者暂缓遣返计划”（DACA）上看到了这一点。

sentences.en: You see that with so many different things.
sentences.zh: 你在许多不同的事情上都能看到这一点。

sentences.en: I think you really saw it yesterday, loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 我想你昨天确实清楚地看到了这一点。

sentences.en: The people of the United States want to see it coming together, at least to an extent.
sentences.zh: 美国人民想要看到团结，至少在某种程度上是这样。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com进行部分采访的直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: All right, we're ready to go.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们准备开始了。

sentences.en: I'm just going to grab a chair.
sentences.zh: 我先去搬把椅子。

sentences.en: How's my sound?
sentences.zh: 我的声音怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm actually moving my phone a little.
sentences.zh: 我其实正在稍微移动一下手机。

sentences.en: I hear you have a way to take away my Brooklyn accent.
sentences.zh: 听说你有办法去掉我的布鲁克林口音？

sentences.en: You don't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 你可不想那样做。

sentences.en: No, I don't.
sentences.zh: 不，我不想。

sentences.en: Colleague Carl Hulse interviewed Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer in his office on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 同事卡尔·赫尔斯在国会山的办公室里采访了参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默。

sentences.en: So you have to be feeling pretty good about what's going on in the last few days.
sentences.zh: 所以你对过去几天发生的事情一定感觉相当不错吧。

sentences.en: I really do.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's kind of a bipartisan breakthrough.
sentences.zh: 这算是一种两党合作的突破。

sentences.en: You know, when Leader Pelosi and I walked into the President Trump's office, we didn't know what to expect.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当佩洛西领袖和我走进特朗普总统的办公室时，我们不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: And of course, everyone's sitting there, McConnell and Ryan and the Treasury Secretary,
sentences.zh: 当然，每个人都坐在那里，麦康奈尔、瑞安、财政部长，

sentences.en: Mnuchin, and Chief of Staff Kelly and Vice President Pence.
sentences.zh: 姆努钦，还有幕僚长凯利和副总统彭斯。

sentences.en: We were sort of outnumbered.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有点寡不敌众。

sentences.en: They said, this is how we want it.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这就是我们想要的方式。

sentences.en: This is really Leader McConnell and Leader Ryan.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是麦康奈尔领袖和瑞安领袖的意思。

sentences.en: And we could have said, well, we're not going to help you at all.
sentences.zh: 我们本可以说，好吧，我们一点忙都不会帮。

sentences.en: Instead, we proposed a compromise.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们提出了一个妥协方案。

sentences.en: You know, in the past, Republicans have said, we're not going to give any help to avoid not paying our debt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，过去共和党人曾说，我们不会提供任何帮助来避免债务违约。

sentences.en: And even we may try to shut down the government.
sentences.zh: 甚至我们可能会试图让政府停摆。

sentences.en: We said, we're not going to do either of those.
sentences.zh: 我们说，这两件事我们都不会做。

sentences.en: But we want to keep our leverage.
sentences.zh: 但我们想保持我们的筹码。

sentences.en: And if we do three months for each, that will be fair to you, fair to us.
sentences.zh: 如果我们各做三个月，这对你们公平，对我们也公平。

sentences.en: And Trump, to his credit, understood that, understood that we were compromising, understood that we were sort of trying not to just be partisan and try to work for our advantage.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，值得称赞的是，他理解了这一点，理解了我们在妥协，理解了我们是在试图避免党派偏见，而不是仅仅为了我们的利益。

sentences.en: But at the same time, we didn't want to give the store away.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们也不想把家底都赔进去。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: We don't know if this will be a pathway to the future or not.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道这是否会成为未来的路径。

sentences.en: But it would be nice if it would.
sentences.zh: 但如果能这样就太好了。

sentences.en: Well, what was it like in there?
sentences.zh: 那么，里面是什么情况？

sentences.en: Would you say it was tense?
sentences.zh: 你会说当时气氛紧张吗？

sentences.en: No, it's sort of friendly.
sentences.zh: 不，气氛还算友好。

sentences.en: I mean, the one thing, look, Trump and I have gone at each other for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有一件事，你看，特朗普和我已经针锋相对很久了。

sentences.en: He's called me some names.
sentences.zh: 他给我起过一些绰号。

sentences.en: But the one thing we've had is we're New Yorkers.
sentences.zh: 但我们有一点共同点，那就是我们都是纽约人。

sentences.en: We're pretty direct and we talk right at each other.
sentences.zh: 我们都很直率，说话直来直去。

sentences.en: And it worked.
sentences.zh: 而且这奏效了。

sentences.en: There's a picture that someone took from outside.
sentences.zh: 有人在外面拍了一张照片。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: What was going on at that moment?
sentences.zh: 那一刻发生了什么？

sentences.en: Okay, I'll tell you what went on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我告诉你发生了什么。

sentences.en: This is actually what went on.
sentences.zh: 这实际上就是当时发生的事情。

sentences.en: Trump is saying to me, look out the window.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对我说，看窗外。

sentences.en: There are all those photographers.
sentences.zh: 那里有所有的摄影师。

sentences.en: Maybe we should go out together and announce this.
sentences.zh: 也许我们应该一起出去宣布这件事。

sentences.en: And I said to him, I don't think we should go out together because honestly, Mr. President, I don't know what you'd say and I might have to contradict you.
sentences.zh: 我对他说，我认为我们不应该一起出去，因为老实说，总统先生，我不知道你会说什么，我可能不得不反驳你。

sentences.en: He laughed.
sentences.zh: 他笑了。

sentences.en: Then Kelly was standing there.
sentences.zh: 当时凯利站在那里。

sentences.en: And I said, I'll bet General Kelly has the same problem.
sentences.zh: 我说，我敢打赌凯利将军也有同样的困扰。

sentences.en: And they both laughed.
sentences.zh: 他们俩都笑了。

sentences.en: That's what was happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是当时发生的事情。

sentences.en: It was already done.
sentences.zh: 事情已经定下来了。

sentences.en: It wasn't any part of the deal.
sentences.zh: 这并不是交易的一部分。

sentences.en: It was already done.
sentences.zh: 事情已经定下来了。

sentences.en: I was being emphatic, but in my sort of usual Brooklyn way, nothing.
sentences.zh: 我当时说话很强调，但用的是我那种典型的布鲁克林方式，没什么别的。

sentences.en: But you said you and Trump do have a history, but he's also been a guy who contributed to your campaigns.
sentences.zh: 但你说你和特朗普确实有历史，而且他也是一个为你的竞选捐过款的人。

sentences.en: You had a relationship.
sentences.zh: 你们曾经有过一段关系。

sentences.en: This would sum up the history a little bit.
sentences.zh: 这可以稍微总结一下那段历史。

sentences.en: It's the first day at the White House where they have the four leaders, the same people who are at this meeting, Leader McConnell, Speaker Ryan, Leader Pelosi, myself.
sentences.zh: 那是白宫的第一天，四位领袖都在场，就是这次会议上的那些人，麦康奈尔领袖、瑞安议长、佩洛西领袖，还有我自己。

sentences.en: All his staff is there.
sentences.zh: 他所有的幕僚都在场。

sentences.en: It's the first, you name it, Priebus, Bannon, all of them, you name it, they were all there.
sentences.zh: 那是第一次，你说得出的名字，普里巴斯、班农，所有人，你随便说，他们都在那儿。

sentences.en: And he opens up talking to me and he says, I had the first fundraiser Chuck Schumer ever had.
sentences.zh: 他开口对我说话，他说，我举办了查克·舒默有史以来的第一场筹款活动。

sentences.en: I said, not really.
sentences.zh: 我说，并不是真的。

sentences.en: And then he said, it raised $2 million.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，那场活动筹集了200万美元。

sentences.en: I said, $263,000, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 我说，是26.3万美元，总统先生。

sentences.en: And the whole place broke up.
sentences.zh: 整个会场都笑翻了。

sentences.en: That sort of sums up our relationship.
sentences.zh: 这大概总结了我们的关系。

sentences.en: So were you surprised when he took your deal?
sentences.zh: 那么当他接受你的提议时，你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you could see it evolve.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到事态的发展。

sentences.en: He started off the meeting sort of on the other side and we managed to persuade him.
sentences.zh: 他开始会议时站在另一边，但我们成功说服了他。

sentences.en: It was pretty good.
sentences.zh: 这相当不错。

sentences.en: So you got another call from Trump today?
sentences.zh: 所以你今天又接到了特朗普的电话？

sentences.en: I was there again today.
sentences.zh: 我今天又去那儿了。

sentences.en: No, but also- I got a call early this morning.
sentences.zh: 不，还有——我今天一大早就接到了电话。

sentences.en: He said, this was so great.
sentences.zh: 他说，这太棒了。

sentences.en: And here's what he said.
sentences.zh: 他是这么说的。

sentences.en: He said, do you watch Fox News?
sentences.zh: 他说，你看福克斯新闻吗？

sentences.en: I said, not really.
sentences.zh: 我说，不太看。

sentences.en: He said, they're praising you.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们正在称赞你。

sentences.en: But he said, and your stations, meaning, I guess, MSNBC, CNN, are praising me.
sentences.zh: 但他又说，还有你的那些电视台，我想是指MSNBC、CNN，正在称赞我。

sentences.en: This is great.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: You guys have had some tough times with the new president, right?
sentences.zh: 你们和这位新总统经历了一些艰难时期，对吧？

sentences.en: But is this a turning point?
sentences.zh: 但这是否是一个转折点？

sentences.en: I'm wondering, is this a turning point?
sentences.zh: 我在想，这是否是一个转折点？

sentences.en: It is too early to tell.
sentences.zh: 现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: The proof of the pudding will be in the eating.
sentences.zh: 路遥知马力，日久见人心。

sentences.en: If the president abandons the hard right positions he's always had, we're not going to obstruct for its own sake.
sentences.zh: 如果总统放弃他一贯坚持的极右立场，我们不会为了反对而反对。

sentences.en: I told him that.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过他这一点。

sentences.en: I think it's either an aberration, maybe.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能只是一个反常现象。

sentences.en: But it's possible that they've learned that just riding and hugging the hard right doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 但也有可能他们已经意识到，仅仅依靠和拥抱极右翼是行不通的。

sentences.en: And if that happens, maybe some things could get done.
sentences.zh: 如果发生这种情况，也许有些事情就能办成了。

sentences.en: Or was he just trying to punish the Republican leaders and he was mad at them over health care?
sentences.zh: 还是说他只是想惩罚共和党领袖，因为他在医改问题上对他们很生气？

sentences.en: What do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: People have speculated that, and obviously he doesn't get along so well with them.
sentences.zh: 人们对此有过猜测，显然他与他们的关系确实不太好。

sentences.en: But being in that room, I don't think he may.
sentences.zh: 但在那个房间里，我不认为他会那样做。

sentences.en: If that had happened, he would have been with us from the outset, and he wasn't.
sentences.zh: 如果真是那样，他从一开始就会和我们站在一起，但他没有。

sentences.en: So we'll see.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拭目以待。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's too early to tell.
sentences.zh: 现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: Carl's full interview with Senator Schumer is Saturday's episode of our weekend podcast, The New Washington.
sentences.zh: 卡尔对舒默参议员的完整采访将收录在周六的周末播客《新华盛顿》中。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Look at the size of this storm.
sentences.zh: 看看这场风暴的规模。

sentences.en: It's huge.
sentences.zh: 太巨大了。

sentences.en: It's wider than our entire state and could cause major and life-threatening impacts on both coasts, coast to coaSt.
sentences.zh: 它的宽度超过了我们整个州，可能会对两岸造成重大且危及生命的冲击，从海岸到海岸。

sentences.en: Regardless of which coast you live on, be prepared to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 无论你住在哪个海岸，都要做好撤离准备。

sentences.en: The governor of Florida, Rick Scott, has issued large-scale evacuation orders as Hurricane Irma heads for the state, with winds reaching up to 175 miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州州长里克·斯科特已发布大规模撤离令，飓风“艾尔玛”正向该州袭来，风速高达每小时175英里。

sentences.en: We are being very aggressive in our preparation for this storm.
sentences.zh: 我们正在非常积极地为这场风暴做准备。

sentences.en: Every Floridian, every family should take this seriously and be aggressive.
sentences.zh: 每一位佛罗里达人，每一个家庭都应该认真对待并积极行动起来。

sentences.en: You've got to protect your family.
sentences.zh: 你必须保护好你的家人。

sentences.en: Possessions can be replaced.
sentences.zh: 财产可以被替代。

sentences.en: Your family cannot.
sentences.zh: 但你的家人不能。

sentences.en: The storm has already killed seven people and devastated the Caribbean islands in its path, destroying 95% of the buildings in St. Martin,
sentences.zh: 这场风暴已经造成7人死亡，并摧毁了加勒比海沿途岛屿，摧毁了圣马丁岛95%的建筑，

sentences.en: leaving half the people of Barbuda homeless, and cutting off power to 70% of Puerto Rico.
sentences.zh: 导致巴布达岛一半的人无家可归，并切断了波多黎各70%的电力供应。

sentences.en: And during a speech at George Mason University in Virginia on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 在周四于弗吉尼亚州乔治梅森大学的一次演讲中。

sentences.en: It's a great honor for me to be here today to address a very important topic.
sentences.zh: 今天能在这里就一个非常重要的话题发表演讲，我感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: Education Secretary Betsy DeVos announced that the Trump administration would begin rewriting the rules for how colleges and universities handle sexual assault cases.
sentences.zh: 教育部长贝齐·德沃斯宣布，特朗普政府将开始重写高校处理性侵案件的规则。

sentences.en: The truth is that the system established by the prior administration has failed too many students.
sentences.zh: 事实是，前任政府建立的制度辜负了太多的学生。

sentences.en: After listening to advocates on both sides,
sentences.zh: 在听取了双方倡导者的意见后，

sentences.en: DeVos has concluded that the guidelines put in place by the Obama administration to protect victims had repeatedly deprived the rights of the accused.
sentences.zh: 德沃斯得出结论，奥巴马政府为保护受害者而制定的指导方针一再剥夺了被指控者的权利。

sentences.en: With the heavy hand of Washington tipping the balance of her scale, the sad reality is that Lady Justice is not blind on campuses today.
sentences.zh: 随着华盛顿的强力干预倾斜了天平，可悲的现实是，正义女神在今天的校园里不再蒙眼。

sentences.en: This unraveling of justice is shameful.
sentences.zh: 这种正义的崩塌是可耻的。

sentences.en: The Daily is produced by Theo Balcom, Lindsay Garrison, Rachel Quester, Annie Brown, Andy Mills, and Christopher Wirth.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》由西奥·巴尔科姆、琳赛·加里森、雷切尔·奎斯特、安妮·布朗、安迪·米尔斯和克里斯托弗·沃斯制作。

sentences.en: Lisa Tobin is our executive producer.
sentences.zh: 丽莎·托宾是我们的执行制片人。

sentences.en: Samantha Hennig is our editorial director.
sentences.zh: 萨曼莎·亨尼格是我们的编辑总监。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的Jim Brunberg和Ben Landsberg创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Brad Fisher, Peter Sale, Sam Dolnick, and Michaela Bouchard.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢Brad Fisher、Peter Sale、Sam Dolnick和Michaela Bouchard。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: See you Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假日待客指南。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑环境才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种喝到断片才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这可是个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您常用的播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.zh: 《Wirecutter秀》，欢迎在《纽约时报》应用程序或您常用的播客平台收听。
